mapper.select: SELECT w.id,w.version,w.title,w.story,w.message,l.id AS revision_id,l.title AS lyric_title,l.lyrics, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lyric_revision v WHERE v.work_id=l.work_id AND (v.created_at<l.created_at OR (v.created_at=l.created_at AND v.id<=l.id))) AS lyric_number FROM music_work w LEFT JOIN lyric_revision l ON l.id=( SELECT r.id FROM lyric_revision r WHERE r.work_id=w.id AND (LOWER(r.lyrics) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(r.title) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(r.title)=#{exact} THEN 0 WHEN LOWER(r.lyrics) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, r.created_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE w.owner_id=#{owner} AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND (l.id IS NOT NULL OR LOWER(w.title) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(w.story) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(w.message) LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(w.title)=#{exact} OR LOWER(l.title)=#{exact} THEN 0 WHEN l.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, w.updated_at DESC,w.id DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT w.id, (SELECT v.id FROM music_video_project v WHERE v.work_id=w.id AND v.creator_id=w.owner_id AND v.state IN ('READY','QUEUED','RUNNING','ASSEMBLING','UNCERTAIN') ORDER BY CASE WHEN v.state='READY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,v.created_at DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS video_id, (SELECT v.state FROM music_video_project v WHERE v.work_id=w.id AND v.creator_id=w.owner_id AND v.state IN ('READY','QUEUED','RUNNING','ASSEMBLING','UNCERTAIN') ORDER BY CASE WHEN v.state='READY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,v.created_at DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS video_state, (SELECT CASE WHEN q.error_code='LYRICS_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE q.status END FROM quick_creation q WHERE q.work_id=w.id ORDER BY q.created_at DESC,q.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS quick_status, (SELECT t.status FROM generation_task t WHERE t.work_id=w.id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS task_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generation_task t WHERE t.work_id=w.id AND t.status IN ('QUEUED','SUBMITTING','RUNNING','SAVING')) AS active_tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generation_task t WHERE t.work_id=w.id AND t.status='SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN') AS unknown_tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lyric_revision l WHERE l.work_id=w.id AND l.work_version=w.version) AS lyric_count, c.cover_id,m.id AS audio_id,m.origin AS audio_origin, COALESCE(t.title,NULLIF(w.title,''), (SELECT l.title FROM lyric_revision l WHERE l.work_id=w.id ORDER BY l.created_at DESC,l.id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS song_title FROM music_work w LEFT JOIN work_cover c ON c.work_id=w.id LEFT JOIN media_asset m ON m.id=COALESCE( (SELECT s.asset_id FROM work_audio_selection s WHERE s.work_id=w.id), (SELECT a.id FROM media_asset a WHERE a.work_id=w.id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM section_edit e WHERE e.task_id=a.generation_task_id) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT 1)) LEFT JOIN generation_task t ON t.id=m.generation_task_id WHERE w.owner_id=#{owner} AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.id IN
#{workId}
